title: Works for small areas for sealing
text: Works for small areas for sealing. The description is misleading..it says " weather seal tape" but it has no tape on it. It has a very smooth side that is coated like so it can stick to the air conditioner or window creating a seal. The size is 1 inch square so you might have to use it doubled. You get 2 rolls so there is enough to seal around all 4 sides if you need it.
